title: Crusted Gears
description: This modpack transforms your Minecraft survival into a massive industrial and exploration journey. It forces you to rethink automation from basic gears to quantum lasers while exploring colossally overhauled dungeons and realistic mountain ranges
body:
### **🌍 Welcome to Crusted Gears**

**Crusted Gears** is a premium 1.21.1 NeoForge modpack where breathtaking world generation meets heavy industrial engineering.

This project bridges the gap between raw nature and high-tech factories. You will progress through three distinct eras of automation, starting with mechanical kinetic energy in **Create**, moving into chemical processing and nuclear power with **Mekanism**, and dominating the endgame using sci-fi particle lasers from **Oritech**.

To fuel your industry, you must venture out into a world reshaped by **Tectonic** and **Biomes O' Plenty**, featuring massive mountain ranges and dangerous, fully overhauled dungeons from **YUNG's Suite**. The survival experience is enhanced with dimensional cooking via **Farmer's Delight** and portable storage from **Sophisticated Backpacks**.

Engineered for a smooth plug-and-play experience, Crusted Gears comes fully optimized for high FPS, pre-packaged with **Complementary Shaders**, integrated with **Essential** for instant multiplayer hosting, and synced with a custom **Discord Rich Presence**.
